+## Administrative relaunch after infrastructure failure
+
+The original frozen `overt_covert_mechanisms_20261016` attempt stopped after
+13 retained requests: ten completed and three HTTP 401 failures stating a missing
+authentication header. It produced no complete round, no passing control gate and
+no main-validation call. All partial records and unknown-cost reservations remain
+in that original archive. Its known provider cost was US$0.0078076; accounting
+including three unresolved reservations was US$0.0808016. These partial outputs
+are not scientific results and are not reused as observations in this relaunch.
+
+This is a fresh administrative relaunch, not a resumed or repaired aborted cohort.
+The main 9501–9520 cases, arms, actor/monitor/annotation prompts, evidence rubric,
+endpoints, analysis, matching and dispatch randomization remain identical. Only
+control cases move from 9531–9534 to fresh seeds 9551–9554, the global scheduling
+limit is reduced from eight to three workers, and the local cap becomes US$49.50.
+The original 13 requests included two concurrent processes totaling up to twelve
+workers; whether concurrency caused the authentication failures is unproven.
+
+Before launch, a separate frozen neutral transport diagnostic must pass all six
+serial and six globally three-worker requests. No paid relaunch call or source
+freeze is permitted while that diagnostic remains pending or fails. The
+coordinator must execute the actor-control phase and monitor-challenge phase
+sequentially, never as simultaneous independent worker pools. No credential,
+proxy, scientific treatment, model, retry policy or successful-output threshold is
+changed in response to observed behavior. The aggregate ceiling is bounded by
+0.0808016 original accounting + 0.25 diagnostic cap + 49.50 relaunch cap =
+US$49.8308016, below the original US$50 envelope. Missing costs retain their
+reservations; the provider statement is not a reconciled bill.
+
+The original 30-reference source freeze is preserved. The relaunch receives its
+own source/plan/prompt freeze only after the diagnostic and offline checks pass;
+its inventory retains the same 30 dependency paths, with new administrative
+source hashes where required. `ADMINISTRATIVE_RELAUNCH_DIFF.json` records exact
+byte comparisons and unchanged main plans/prompts before any relaunch call.
